#Library Set Up

```{r Library Setup}
#creating percentages and tidying data
library(dplyr)
#glm.nb model
library(MASS)
#elastic regression
library(glmnet)
#AUC binomial model check
library(pROC)
#feature importance 
library(caret)
#post-hoc contrasts for models 
library(emmeans)
#GGPlot for graphing
library(ggplot2)
#combining plots
library(cowplot)
```

#Import and Clean Data 

````{r Import Data Set}
setwd("/Users/niamhmccartan/Documents/College/PhD/Papers/CS_Timing/CS_Timing_R")

coldsnap<-read.csv("CS_Timing.csv", 
                 header = TRUE, 
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
```{r Remove early deaths, males and uninfected controls}
CS <- subset(coldsnap, Include == "Yes")
```
```{r Make Treatment Column}
CS$Treatment <- paste(CS$Amplitude, CS$Duration)
```
```{r Set Variables}
CS$A_Temp<-as.numeric(CS$A_Temp)
CS$Real_Avg<-as.numeric(CS$Real_Avg)
CS$Real_CS<-as.numeric(CS$Real_CS)
CS$Bath<-as.factor(CS$Bath)
CS$Timing<-as.factor(CS$Timing)
CS$Amplitude<-as.factor(CS$Amplitude)
CS$Duration<-as.factor(CS$Duration)
CS$Infection<-as.numeric(CS$Infection)
CS$Spores<-as.numeric(CS$Spores)
CS$Treatment <- as.factor(CS$Treatment)
```
```{r Specifying Order of Factors}
CS$Timing <- factor(CS$Timing, levels = c("Constant", "Before", "During", "After"))
CS$Amplitude <- factor(CS$Amplitude, levels = c("0", "-3", "-6"))
CS$Duration <- factor(CS$Duration, levels = c("0", "3", "6"))
CS$Treatment <- factor(CS$Treatment, levels = c("0 0", "-3 3", "-3 6", "-6 3", "-6 6"))
```
```{r Adding Proportion Infected and Standard Error of Burden Column}
CS = CS %>%
  group_by(Treatment, A_Temp, Timing) %>% 
  #Make proportion infected columns 
  add_count(Treatment) %>% 
  mutate(
    nn = sum(Infection != 0),
    Prop = nn/n,
  #creating binomial confidence intervals
  se.I = sqrt(Prop * (1-Prop)/n),
  lower.I = pmax(Prop - (se.I * 1.96), 0),
  upper.I = pmin(Prop + (se.I * 1.96), 1)
  ) %>% 
  
  #Make standard error columns
  mutate(
    mean = mean(Spores, na.rm = T),
    sd.B = sd(Spores, na.rm = T),
    se.B = sd.B/sqrt(n())) %>%
  ungroup()
```
```{r Centre Average Temperature}
# Centering the 'Real_Avg' variable
CS$Real_Avg_Cent <- scale(CS$Real_Avg, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
CS$Real_Avg_Cent <- as.numeric(CS$Real_Avg_Cent)
```
```{r make Timing_Treatment column}
CS$Timing_Treatment <- paste(CS$Timing, CS$Treatment)
CS$Timing_Treatment <- factor(CS$Timing_Treatment, levels = c("Constant 0 0", 	
                                                    "Before -3 3", "Before -3 6", "Before -6 3", "Before -6 6",
                                                    "During -3 3", "During -3 6", "During -6 3", "During -6 6",
                                                    "After -3 3", "After -3 6", "After -6 3", "After -6 6"))
```
```{r Extra Subsets}
# Remove NAs from the data set not relevant as we are only looking at infected individuals
CS.NA <- na.omit(CS)
#Subset for only core average temperatures
CSC <- subset(CS, A_Temp %in% c("14","17","20","23"))
CSC$A_Temp <- as.factor(CSC$A_Temp)
```
```{r Timing Subsets Burden}
#making a subset by each timing and constant controls 
CSB.before <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("Before","Constant")) 
CSB.during<- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("During","Constant"))
CSB.after <- subset(CS.NA, Timing %in% c("After","Constant"))
```
```{r Timing Subsets Infection}
#making a subset by each timing and constant controls 
CSI.before <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("Before","Constant")) 
CSI.during <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("During","Constant"))
CSI.after <- subset(CS, Timing %in% c("After","Constant"))
```

```{r Calculate degree day for both my threshold and Kirk et al}
# STEP 1: Calculate Degree Days for thresholds
CS.NA$DD_11.2 <- pmax(0, CS.NA$Real_CS - 11.2)
# STEP 2: Multiply by number of days each individual was alive before dissection
CS.NA$DD_11.2_total <- CS.NA$DD_11.2 * CS.NA$Day
#Scale dd to redcue colinearity
CS.NA$DD_scaled.M <- scale(CS.NA$DD_11.2_total, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)
```

#Check Baths

```{r Temperature and Bath Interactions for Infection}
Bath.treat.CI <- glm(Infection ~ Bath, family = binomial, data = CS)
summary(Bath.treat.CI)

Bath.Test.treat.CI <- anova(Bath.treat.CI, test = "Chi")
Bath.Test.treat.CI
```
```{r Temperature and Bath Interactions for Burden}
Bath.CB <- glm.nb(Spores ~ Bath, data = CS)
summary(Bath.CB)

Bath.Test.CB <- anova(Bath.CB, test = "Chi")
Bath.Test.CB
```

#Infection Model

```{r Centred Infection Model}
#using a quadratic polynomial as it gives the lowest AIC out of the suitable models
quadratic.treat.CI <- glm(Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * Timing * Treatment, family = binomial, data = CS)
summary(quadratic.treat.CI)
```
```{r Elastic Net Regression for Infection}
# Prepare the data
x.treat.CI <- model.matrix(Infection ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 2) * Timing * Treatment, data = CS)  # Create the design matrix
y.treat.CI <- CS$Infection  # Extract the response variable
```
```{r Finding the optimal aplha}
#trying various alphas to find which one is the most suitable 
foldid.treat.CI<- sample(1:10, size = length(y.treat.CI), replace = TRUE)
cv1.treat.CI  <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CI, y.treat.CI, foldid = foldid.treat.CI, family = "binomial", alpha = 1)
cv.5.treat.CI <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CI, y.treat.CI, foldid = foldid.treat.CI, family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5)
cv0.treat.CI  <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CI, y.treat.CI, foldid = foldid.treat.CI, family = "binomial", alpha = 0)

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
plot(cv1.treat.CI); plot(cv.5.treat.CI); plot(cv0.treat.CI)
plot(log(cv1.treat.CI$lambda)   , cv1.treat.CI$cvm , pch = 19, col = "red",
     xlab = "log(Lambda)", ylab = cv1.treat.CI$name)
points(log(cv.5.treat.CI$lambda), cv.5.treat.CI$cvm, pch = 19, col = "grey")
points(log(cv0.treat.CI$lambda) , cv0.treat.CI$cvm , pch = 19, col = "blue")
legend("topleft", legend = c("alpha= 1", "alpha= .5", "alpha 0"),
       pch = 19, col = c("red","grey","blue"))

# Extract minimum mean cross-validated deviance
min.dev <- c(
  alpha1  = min(cv1.treat.CI$cvm),
  alpha05 = min(cv.5.treat.CI$cvm),
  alpha0  = min(cv0.treat.CI$cvm)
)

# Print out the minimum deviance for each alpha
print(min.dev)

```
```{r Model Fitting}
# Elastic regression model 
elfit.b.treat.CI <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CI, y.treat.CI, family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5)  # Fit a ridge regression model

# Select optimal tuning pattern (lambda) for ridge regression
opt_lambda.treat.CI <- elfit.b.treat.CI$lambda.min  # Optimal lambda value for regression via CV

# Refit the model using the selected lambda
elfit.fin.treat.CI <- glmnet(x.treat.CI, y.treat.CI, family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5, lambda = opt_lambda.treat.CI)  
# Fit the ridge regression model with the selected lambda
```
```{r bootstrapped significance testing for the coefficients of infection}
# Number of bootstrap iterations
num_bootstraps.treat.CI <- 50000

# Empty list to store bootstrap coefficients
bootstrap_coefs_list.treat.CI <- vector("list", length = num_bootstraps.treat.CI)

# Set the seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Perform bootstrapping
for (i in 1:num_bootstraps.treat.CI) {
  # Sample with replacement from the data
  sample_indices.treat.CI <- sample(nrow(x.treat.CI), replace = TRUE)
  x_sampled.treat.CI <- x.treat.CI[sample_indices.treat.CI, ]
  y_sampled.treat.CI <- y.treat.CI[sample_indices.treat.CI]
  
  # Fit the elastic net model on the sampled data
  model_fit.treat.CI <- glmnet(x_sampled.treat.CI, y_sampled.treat.CI, family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5, lambda = opt_lambda.treat.CI)
  
  # Store the coefficients in the list
  bootstrap_coefs_list.treat.CI[[i]] <- as.vector(coef(model_fit.treat.CI, s = opt_lambda.treat.CI))
}

# Convert the list of bootstrap coefficients to a matrix
bootstrap_coefs.treat.CI <- do.call(rbind, bootstrap_coefs_list.treat.CI)

# Calculate the 95% confidence intervals for each coefficient
lower_ci.treat.CI <- apply(bootstrap_coefs.treat.CI, 2, function(coef_col) quantile(coef_col, 0.025))
upper_ci.treat.CI <- apply(bootstrap_coefs.treat.CI, 2, function(coef_col) quantile(coef_col, 0.975))

# Convert the coefficients to a matrix
coef_matrix.treat.CI <- as.matrix(coef(elfit.fin.treat.CI, s = opt_lambda.treat.CI))

# Combine the results into a data frame for easy interpretation
coef_summary.treat.CI <- data.frame(Coefficient = colnames(coef_matrix.treat.CI),
                              Estimate = coef_matrix.treat.CI,
                              Lower.treat.CI = lower_ci.treat.CI,
                              Upper.treat.CI = upper_ci.treat.CI)

# Print the summary
print(coef_summary.treat.CI)
```
```{r Feature Importance for Infection}
# Extract the coefficients from the final model
coef_matrix.treat.CI <- as.matrix(coef(elfit.fin.treat.CI, s = opt_lambda.treat.CI))

# Get the absolute values of coefficients to identify feature importance
feature_importance.treat.CI <- abs(coef_matrix.treat.CI[-1,])

# Sort the features by importance (highest to lowest)
sorted_features.treat.CI <- feature_importance.treat.CI[order(-feature_importance.treat.CI)]

# Get the corresponding feature names
sorted_feature_names.treat.CI <- colnames(coef_matrix.treat.CI)[-1][order(-feature_importance.treat.CI)]

# Combine the feature names with the sorted feature importance values
sorted_feature_importance_table.treat.CI <- data.frame(Feature = sorted_feature_names.treat.CI,
                                                 Importance = sorted_features.treat.CI)

# Print the sorted feature importance table
print(sorted_feature_importance_table.treat.CI)
```
```{r Model Fit (Area Under the Curve)}
# Calculate the cross-validated AUC score using the training data
# The predict() function with type = "response" will give cross-validated predicted probabilities
cv_predicted_probabilities.treat.CI <- predict(elfit.b.treat.CI, s = "lambda.min", newx = x.treat.CI, type = "response")
cv_roc_curve.treat.CI <- roc(y.treat.CI, cv_predicted_probabilities.treat.CI)
cv_auc_score.treat.CI <- auc(cv_roc_curve.treat.CI)

# Print the cross-validated AUC score
print(paste("Cross-Validated AUC Score:", cv_auc_score.treat.CI))
```

  geom_smooth(aes(x = A_Temp, y = Prop, colour = Treatment), lty = "dashed",
              method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), formula = y ~ poly(x,2),
              se = FALSE, size = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.I, ymax = upper.I), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17),

  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25)) +  # Use shapes 21-25

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#999999", "#CC79A9", "#70135C", "#57B4E9", "#0D72B2")) +  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(8, 23, 3)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))

#Burden Model

```{r Centred Cubic NB Burden Model}
#Lowest AIC found a cubic fit was most suitable for the data as it is nonlinear
#use data set with NAs removed as they were uninfected and so never had a spore burden
nb.treat.CB <- glm.nb(Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * Timing * Treatment, data = CS.NA)
summary(nb.treat.CB)

anova.treat.CB <- anova(nb.treat.CB, test = "Chi")
anova.treat.CB
```
```{r Negative Binomial Elastic Regression}
# Prepare the data
x.treat.CB <- model.matrix(Spores ~ poly(Real_Avg_Cent, 3) * Timing * Treatment, data = CS.NA)
y.treat.CB <- CS.NA$Spores
```
```{r Finding optimal alpha}
#different way to find the most suitable alpha but still involves modelling and finding the lowest AIC out of 1, 0.5, 0
#theta needs to be manually specified in glmnet so we used the theta present in the GLM 
cv_lasso.treat.CB <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CB, y.treat.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.3020), alpha = 0.9)
cv_mix.treat.CB   <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CB, y.treat.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.3020), alpha = 0.87)
cv_ridge.treat.CB <- cv.glmnet(x.treat.CB, y.treat.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.3020), alpha = 0.85)

# Calculate number of non-zero coefficients for each model
num_nonzero_lasso.treat.CB <- sum(coef(cv_lasso.treat.CB, s = 0) != 0)
num_nonzero_mix.treat.CB <- sum(coef(cv_mix.treat.CB, s = 0) != 0)
num_nonzero_ridge.treat.CB <- sum(coef(cv_ridge.treat.CB, s = 0) != 0)

# Calculate AIC and BIC
n.treat.CB <- length(y.treat.CB)

aic_lasso.treat.CB <- n.treat.CB * log(min(cv_lasso.treat.CB$cvm)) + 2 * num_nonzero_lasso.treat.CB
aic_mix.treat.CB   <- n.treat.CB * log(min(cv_mix.treat.CB$cvm)) + 2 * num_nonzero_mix.treat.CB
aic_ridge.treat.CB <- n.treat.CB * log(min(cv_ridge.treat.CB$cvm)) + 2 * num_nonzero_ridge.treat.CB

bic_lasso.treat.CB <- n.treat.CB * log(min(cv_lasso.treat.CB$cvm)) + log(n.treat.CB) * num_nonzero_lasso.treat.CB
bic_mix.treat.CB   <- n.treat.CB * log(min(cv_mix.treat.CB$cvm)) + log(n.treat.CB) * num_nonzero_mix.treat.CB
bic_ridge.treat.CB <- n.treat.CB * log(min(cv_ridge.treat.CB$cvm)) + log(n.treat.CB) * num_nonzero_ridge.treat.CB

best_alpha_aic.treat.CB <- c(1, 0.99, 0.98)[which.min(c(aic_lasso.treat.CB, aic_mix.treat.CB, aic_ridge.treat.CB))]
best_alpha_bic.treat.CB <- c(1, 0.99, 0.98)[which.min(c(bic_lasso.treat.CB, bic_mix.treat.CB, bic_ridge.treat.CB))]

data.frame(
  alpha = c(1, 0.99, 0.98),
  AIC = c(aic_lasso.treat.CB, aic_mix.treat.CB, aic_ridge.treat.CB),
  BIC = c(bic_lasso.treat.CB, bic_mix.treat.CB, bic_ridge.treat.CB)
)
```
```{r Initial Model fit}
# Fit the elastic net model using the theta from the glm.nb 
elfit.nb.treat.CB <- glmnet(x.treat.CB, y.treat.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.3020), alpha = 0.87)
```
```{r Finding the optimal lambda}
# Calculate AIC for each lambda
aic_values <- sapply(elfit.nb.treat.CB$lambda, function(lambda) {
  fitted_values <- predict(elfit.nb.treat.CB, newx = x.treat.CB, s = lambda, type = "response")
  logLikelihood <- sum(dnbinom(y.treat.CB, mu = fitted_values, size = 1.3020, log = TRUE))
  k <- sum(coef(elfit.nb.treat.CB, s = lambda, exact = TRUE) != 0)
  -2 * logLikelihood + 2 * k
})

# Calculate BIC for each lambda
n <- length(y.treat.CB)
bic_values <- sapply(elfit.nb.treat.CB$lambda, function(lambda) {
  fitted_values <- predict(elfit.nb.treat.CB, newx = x.treat.CB, s = lambda, type = "response")
  logLikelihood <- sum(dnbinom(y.treat.CB, mu = fitted_values, size = 1.3020, log = TRUE))
  k <- sum(coef(elfit.nb.treat.CB, s = lambda, exact = TRUE) != 0)
  -2 * logLikelihood + log(n) * k
})

# Print AIC and BIC values
AIC.BIC.treat.CB <- data.frame(lambda = elfit.nb.treat.CB$lambda, AIC = aic_values, BIC = bic_values)
```
```{r Optimal Lambda Elastic Regression}
lambda.treat.CB <- elfit.nb.treat.CB$lambda
#set the lambda as the lowest AIC 
lambda.AIC.treat.CB <- 0.033362992

#final regression with the lowest AIC valued lambda 
elfit.aic.treat.CB <- glmnet(x.treat.CB, y.treat.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.3020), alpha = 0.87, lambda = lambda.AIC.treat.CB)
```
```{r Bootstrap significance testing for burden}
# Number of bootstrap iterations
num_bootstraps.treat.CB <- 50000

# Empty list to store bootstrap coefficients
bootstrap_coefs_list.treat.CB <- vector("list", length = num_bootstraps.treat.CB)

# Set the seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Perform bootstrapping
for (i in 1:num_bootstraps.treat.CB) {
  # Sample with replacement from the data
  sample_indices.treat.CB <- sample(nrow(x.treat.CB), replace = TRUE)
  x_sampled.treat.CB <- x.treat.CB[sample_indices.treat.CB, ]
  y_sampled.treat.CB <- y.treat.CB[sample_indices.treat.CB]
  
  # Fit the elastic net model on the sampled data
  model_fit.treat.CB <- glmnet(x_sampled.treat.CB, y_sampled.treat.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.3020), alpha = 0.87, lambda = lambda.AIC.treat.CB)
  
  # Store the coefficients in the list
  bootstrap_coefs_list.treat.CB[[i]] <- as.vector(coef(model_fit.treat.CB, s = lambda.AIC.treat.CB))
}

# Convert the list of bootstrap coefficients to a matrix
bootstrap_coefs.treat.CB <- do.call(rbind, bootstrap_coefs_list.treat.CB)

# Calculate the 95% confidence intervals for each coefficient
lower_ci.treat.CB <- apply(bootstrap_coefs.treat.CB, 2, function(coef_col) quantile(coef_col, 0.025)) #2.5th percentile
upper_ci.treat.CB <- apply(bootstrap_coefs.treat.CB, 2, function(coef_col) quantile(coef_col, 0.975)) #97.5th percentile 

# Convert the coefficients to a matrix
coef_matrix.treat.CB <- as.matrix(coef(elfit.aic.treat.CB, s = lambda.AIC.treat.CB))

# Combine the results into a data frame for easy interpretation
coef_summary.treat.CB <- data.frame(Coefficient = colnames(coef_matrix.treat.CB),
                              Estimate = coef_matrix.treat.CB,
                              Lower.treat.CB = lower_ci.treat.CB,
                              Upper.treat.CB = upper_ci.treat.CB)

# Print the summary
print(coef_summary.treat.CB)
```
```{r Feature Importance for Burden}
# Extract the coefficients from the final model
coef_matrix.treat.CB <- as.matrix(coef(elfit.aic.treat.CB, s = lambda.AIC.treat.CB))

# Get the absolute values of coefficients to identify feature importance
feature_importance.treat.CB <- abs(coef_matrix.treat.CB[-1,])

# Sort the features by importance (highest to lowest)
sorted_features.treat.CB <- feature_importance.treat.CB[order(-feature_importance.treat.CB)]

# Get the corresponding feature names
sorted_feature_names.treat.CB <- colnames(coef_matrix.treat.CB)[-1][order(-feature_importance.treat.CB)]

# Combine the feature names with the sorted feature importance values
sorted_feature_importance_table.treat.CB <- data.frame(Feature = sorted_feature_names.treat.CB,
                                                 Importance = sorted_features.treat.CB)

# Print the sorted feature importance table
print(sorted_feature_importance_table.treat.CB)
```

#Burden Graphs

```{r Before Burden and Model}
#making a ggplot plotting by treatment looking at all treatments
CSB.before.plot <- ggplot(CSB.before, aes(x = A_Temp, y = Spores, colour = Treatment, shape = Treatment, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(x = A_Temp, y = Spores, colour = Treatment), 
              method = "glm.nb", formula = y ~ poly(x, 3), se = F, linewidth = 0.75, lty = "dashed") +
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se.B, ymax = mean + se.B), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.6)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 17),
        legend.position = "none") + # Remove the legend
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(21, 22, 23, 24, 25)) +  # Use shapes 21-25
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#999999", "#CC79A9", "#70135C", "#57B4E9", "#0D72B2")) +  # Fill colors matching treatments 
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#999999", "#CC79A9", "#70135C", "#57B4E9", "#0D72B2")) +  
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(8, 23, 3)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,800))

CSB.before.plot

ggsave("CSB.before.plot.png", width = 8.5, height = 6)
```

Before14.CSB <- subset(CSB.before, A_Temp == "14" & Amplitude %in% c("-3","-6"))
Before17.CSB <- subset(CSB.before, A_Temp == "17" & Amplitude %in% c("-3","-6")) 
Before20.CSB <- subset(CSB.before, A_Temp == "20" & Amplitude %in% c("-3","-6"))
Before23.CSB <- subset(CSB.before, A_Temp == "23" & Amplitude %in% c("-3","-6"))
```

```{r 14 Degree Amplitude vs Duration (Day -10)}
Before14.Plot.CSB <- ggplot(Before14.CSB, aes(x = Amplitude, y = Spores, colour = Duration)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 78, ymax = 118),
            fill = "#ECECEC", alpha = 0.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 98, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") + # Line for constant treatment
  stat_summary(fun = "mean", geom = "point", size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se.B, ymax =  mean + se.B), width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(width = 0.3)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank()) +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  theme(legend.position = c(0.65, 0.85), 
        legend.key = element_blank(),  # Removes the box around the legend symbol
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14), 
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  scale_colour_manual("CS Duration", values = c("#40B46A","#966AEA"), 
                      labels = c("3 Days", "6 Days")) +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,800))

#Burden Degree Day Model

```{r glm.nb for degree day model}
# STEP 3: Fit a negative binomial GLM with the degree day predictor (11.2°C threshold)
glmnet_dd_treat_scale.M <- glm.nb(Spores ~ poly(DD_scaled.M, 3) * Timing * Treatment, data = CS.NA)
summary(glmnet_dd_treat_scale.M)
```
```{r Negative Binomial Elastic Regression}
# Prepare the data
x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- model.matrix(Spores ~ poly(DD_scaled.M, 3) * Timing * Treatment, data = CS.NA)

y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- CS.NA$Spores
```
```{r Finding optimal alpha}
#different way to find the most suitable alpha but still involves modelling and finding the lowest AIC out of 1, 0.5, 0
#theta needs to be manually specified in glmnet so we used the theta present in the GLM 
cv_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- cv.glmnet(x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.2627), alpha = 1, maxit = 1e6)
cv_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB   <- cv.glmnet(x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.2627), alpha = 0.9, maxit = 1e6)
cv_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- cv.glmnet(x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.2627), alpha = 0.8, maxit = 1e6)

# Calculate number of non-zero coefficients for each model
num_nonzero_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- sum(coef(cv_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = 0) != 0)
num_nonzero_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- sum(coef(cv_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = 0) != 0)
num_nonzero_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- sum(coef(cv_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = 0) != 0)

# Calculate AIC and BIC
n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- length(y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)

aic_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB * log(min(cv_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$cvm)) + 2 * num_nonzero_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB
aic_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB   <- n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB * log(min(cv_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$cvm)) + 2 * num_nonzero_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB
aic_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB * log(min(cv_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$cvm)) + 2 * num_nonzero_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB

bic_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB * log(min(cv_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$cvm)) + log(n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB) * num_nonzero_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB
bic_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB   <- n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB * log(min(cv_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$cvm)) + log(n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB) * num_nonzero_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB
bic_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB * log(min(cv_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$cvm)) + log(n.dd.treat.scale.M.CB) * num_nonzero_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB

best_alpha_aic.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- c(1, 0.5, 0)[which.min(c(aic_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, aic_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, aic_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB))]
best_alpha_bic.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- c(1, 0.5, 0)[which.min(c(bic_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, bic_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, bic_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB))]

data.frame(
  alpha = c(1, 0.5, 0),
  AIC = c(aic_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, aic_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, aic_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB),
  BIC = c(bic_lasso.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, bic_mix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, bic_ridge.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)
)
```
```{r Initial Model fit}
# Fit the elastic net model using the theta from the glm.nb 
elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- glmnet(x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.2627), alpha = 0.9, maxit = 1e6)
```
```{r Finding the optimal lambda}
# Calculate AIC for each lambda
aic_values <- sapply(elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$lambda, function(lambda) {
  fitted_values <- predict(elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, newx = x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = lambda, type = "response")
  logLikelihood <- sum(dnbinom(y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, mu = fitted_values, size = 1.2627, log = TRUE))
  k <- sum(coef(elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = lambda, exact = TRUE) != 0)
  -2 * logLikelihood + 2 * k
})

# Calculate BIC for each lambda
n <- length(y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)
bic_values <- sapply(elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$lambda, function(lambda) {
  fitted_values <- predict(elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, newx = x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = lambda, type = "response")
  logLikelihood <- sum(dnbinom(y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, mu = fitted_values, size = 1.2627, log = TRUE))
  k <- sum(coef(elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = lambda, exact = TRUE) != 0)
  -2 * logLikelihood + log(n) * k
})

# Print AIC and BIC values
AIC.BIC.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- data.frame(lambda = elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$lambda, AIC = aic_values, BIC = bic_values)
```
```{r Optimal Lambda Elastic Regression}
lambda.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- elfit.nb.dd.treat.scale.M.CB$lambda
#set the lambda as the lowest AIC 
lambda.AIC.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- 0.027802494

#final regression with the lowest AIC valued lambda 
elfit.aic.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- glmnet(x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.2627), alpha = 0.9, lambda = lambda.AIC.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, maxit = 1e6)
```
```{r Bootstrap significance testing for burden}
# Number of bootstrap iterations
num_bootstraps.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- 50000

# Empty list to store bootstrap coefficients
bootstrap_coefs_list.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- vector("list", length = num_bootstraps.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)

# Set the seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Perform bootstrapping
for (i in 1:num_bootstraps.dd.treat.scale.M.CB) {
  # Sample with replacement from the data
  sample_indices.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- sample(nrow(x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB), replace = TRUE)
  x_sampled.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- x.dd.treat.scale.M.CB[sample_indices.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, ]
  y_sampled.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- y.dd.treat.scale.M.CB[sample_indices.dd.treat.scale.M.CB]
  
  # Fit the elastic net model on the sampled data
  model_fit.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- glmnet(x_sampled.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, y_sampled.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, family = negative.binomial(theta = 1.2627), alpha = 0.9, lambda = lambda.AIC.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, maxit = 1e6)
  
  # Store the coefficients in the list
  bootstrap_coefs_list.dd.treat.scale.M.CB[[i]] <- as.vector(coef(model_fit.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = lambda.AIC.dd.treat.scale.M.CB))
}

# Convert the list of bootstrap coefficients to a matrix
bootstrap_coefs.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- do.call(rbind, bootstrap_coefs_list.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)

# Calculate the 95% confidence intervals for each coefficient
lower_ci.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- apply(bootstrap_coefs.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, 2, function(coef_col) quantile(coef_col, 0.025)) #2.5th percentile
upper_ci.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- apply(bootstrap_coefs.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, 2, function(coef_col) quantile(coef_col, 0.975)) #97.5th percentile 

# Convert the coefficients to a matrix
coef_matrix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- as.matrix(coef(elfit.aic.dd.treat.scale.M.CB, s = lambda.AIC.dd.treat.scale.M.CB))

# Combine the results into a data frame for easy interpretation
coef_summary.dd.treat.scale.M.CB <- data.frame(Coefficient = colnames(coef_matrix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB),
                              Estimate = coef_matrix.dd.treat.scale.M.CB,
                              Lower.dd.treat.scale.M.CB = lower_ci.dd.treat.scale.M.CB,
                              Upper.dd.treat.scale.M.CB = upper_ci.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)

# Print the summary
print(coef_summary.dd.treat.scale.M.CB)
```
